question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Luminous
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Luminous**' means giving off light; bright or shining.(चमकदार)

 
 
• **Example**- David's watch has **luminous **numbers.
 
 
 
• '**Radiant**'- Sending out light; shining or glowing brightly.(दीप्तिमान)
 
 
• **Example**- A bird with radiant green and red plumage.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of "**Luminous" **is "**Radiant".**

Therefore, the correct answer is** Radiant.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are a few other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences.

 
• **Laborius(**परिश्रमी): Requiring considerable time and effort.

 
 
• **Example:** The work is very slow and **laborious**.
 
 
 
• **Amiable(**सुशील): Having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner.
 
 
• **Example**- Balard had a kind and **amiable **personality, to which students responded warmly.
 
 
 
• **Luxurious**(शान शौकत): Extremely comfortable or elegant, especially when involving great expense.
 
 
• **Example- **It was one of the most **luxurious **hotel rooms we've ever stayed in.
